from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta


naive = datetime(2026, 8, 23, 9)
observed_at = naive.astimezone(UTC)
timestamp = naive.timestamp()
unbound_observed_at = datetime.astimezone(naive, UTC)
unbound_timestamp = datetime.timestamp(naive)
calendar_timestamp = datetime.fromisocalendar(2026, 34, 7).timestamp()
arithmetic_timestamp = (naive + timedelta(days=1)).timestamp()
minimum_timestamp = datetime.min.replace(year=2026).timestamp()
resolution_timestamp = (datetime.min + datetime.resolution).timestamp()
